name: Video Producer
author: CorvinOS Contributors
description: Create short narrated MP4s from a task description: LLM-written storyboard, per-scene TTS narration, ffmpeg assembly. See docs/ADR-0953 for the current (consolidated) scope versus earlier design plans.
_entry_points_note: Neither this field nor its contents are read by any CorvinOS loader (importlib.metadata.entry_points() reads Python packaging metadata, not this JSON field; the console route loads src/__init__.py directly by path) -- kept only for marketplace manifest schema conformance (tests/test_plugin_registration.py). The 'renderers' sub-block that named now-deleted renderers_skill_2_0/ modules was removed per ADR-0953; 'console_panels'/'skills' are labels, not module paths, so they don't point at dead code the way 'renderers' did.

skills.name: Video Producer
skills.description: Turns a task description into a short narrated MP4 (storyboard, TTS, ffmpeg assembly).
